svg.title: Distillation-Aware Pruning (DAP)
svg.desc: Conventional pruning removes the weights with the smallest immediate damage D. DAP removes the weights with the smallest irrecoverable damage D minus R, where R is what distillation from the teacher can repair, so the pruned student retains less damage after distillation.

g.text: Pruning weight wᵢ causes immediate damage Dᵢ
Distilling from the teacher repairs a part Rᵢ
Conventional pruning: remove the smallest D
DAP: remove the smallest D − R (irrecoverable)
Prune what the teacher can repair
